title: Furukawa Electric Power Systems suspects unauthorised access to a disaster-prevention product shipment system
date_note: Publication date of Security NEXT; the anomaly was detected on October 14.
summary: Furukawa Electric Power Systems, a Furukawa Electric group company, found signs on October 14 that an outside party accessed a web system used for shipment management by its Disaster Prevention Products Division. Orderer and delivery-destination names, addresses and phone numbers may have leaked. It shut the system and servers, and no secondary misuse is confirmed.
plain: A Japanese manufacturer says an outsider may have accessed its shipping system and customer contact details.
exec: Customer and delivery contact data may be exposed; investigation with outside experts continues.
action: Customers should be alert to phishing that uses order details; no further action needed beyond awareness.

validation.note: Security NEXT (Japanese) read in full; cause and scope still under investigation.
